warning: This rule is not an untouched holdout winner. It was one of 97 rules that passed the 2023-only structural gate, and its 2024-2026 diagnostics were subsequently inspected. True confirmation begins only after 2026-06-26.

setup.m15_overextension: 16-bar return / ATR14 at or below the frozen 2023 lower-10% threshold
setup.confirmation: M5 HOLD_BOS within 240 minutes before 1.0 M15-ATR continuation invalidation

quality_gate.formula_d1: (last closed D1 EMA20 - D1 EMA20[4]) / D1 ATR14
quality_gate.formula_m5: (confirmation close - confirmation open) / (confirmation high - confirmation low)

initial_risk.stop: setup episode low minus 0.10 M15 ATR
initial_risk.entry: exact M1 open at confirming M5 close including dynamic spread

profit_management.before_3R: one original risk unit; protective stop remains at -1R
profit_management.at_3R: move original protective floor to +1.5R and add 0.75 risk-unit-equivalent position at the +3R price
profit_management.after_3R: shared exit by a 2.0 M15-ATR chandelier, never below the +1.5R original-coordinate floor
